_comment: Per-track resolutions for the column-vs-tags drift found by
scripts/tag-drift-report.mjs. Settled with the DJ on 2026-09-25.
The migration reads this instead of guessing. Every conflict the report
classes as needing a decision must appear here, or the migration refuses
to run that field — a silent default is how curation gets destroyed.
`resolved` is the exact tag list to end up with, already in final order
and casing. `source` records which side it came from, for the report.
Per field. ' / ' is what TagInput and BulkEditModal join with.
grouping ALSO accepts ' | ' because the files' own TIT1 frame uses it
Nothing else is ever auto-split: not ',', '&', '/', ' x ' or 'ft.'.
Deliberate merges the DJ asked for, applied before the per-track work.
NOT the automatic near-duplicate merging that stays out of scope — each
of these is a named decision. Idempotent: a `from` that no longer
exists is skipped, so re-running does nothing.

genre.why: Settled 2026-09-25: the hyphenated form wins. Both existed because the old normalizer folded casing but left punctuation alone.

_label: Reversed 2026-09-25, later the same day. label was briefly treated as a
DJ-badge namespace because every value in the library was the marker
SERATOCOLLECTION. That was reading the DATA rather than the FIELD: Serato
has a Label column and sources it from the file's publisher frame, which
is what the code has always written. So label is the record label, kept
as typed, and badges live in comment and grouping.
Nothing about the migration changes — label was backfilled from its own
column either way. Only normalizeTagValue changed: it no longer
_scope: comment and album were added on 2026-09-25. Both are TagInput fields
with derived columns, so they carry the same drift risk as the other
five. They turned out to need no per-track decisions: every comment (15)
and album (2) case is tags-only — tags exist, the column is empty — so
the backfill only has to derive the column from the tags it already has.

67._note: Tags across all three fields look imported from another track: filepath is 'VLVT JONES - The Love (Bootleg).mp3' but the artist tag said ATCQ. Column wins throughout.

genre.review: ' x ' is not an approved delimiter, so this stays ONE tag. Split it by hand if you meant Soul + Boogie + Jazz.

grouping._note: split on ' | ', the files' own grouping convention

92._note: Tags had the right split, the column had the right spelling — tags read SEXXY RED.

104._note: A Brooklyn bootleg edit; the B.I.G. blend is deliberate. Tags' split kept, spelling normalised.
